body.text: The Friday ballot sweep reached Ballotpedia on its eleventh attempt — and found a firearm ballot measure this board had never carried. ATF also confirmed a ransomware breach, and the SCOTUS AR-15 case picked up two amicus briefs.

Ballotpedia was reachable and read: Massachusetts carries a veto referendum on An Act Modernizing Firearm Laws (H. 4885) — a vote to keep the 2024 law is a YES, and the repeal side is NO. Arkansas carries a certified Right to Keep and Bear Arms Amendment covering ammunition, accessories and components.

facts.title: 1. Militia-clause amicus wave in Viramontes / Grant
2. ATF confirms ransomware breach after Qilin claim
3. CDC defensive-gun-use record now has named actors

body.text:
• Massachusetts firearm measure confirmed — it's a veto referendum, YES keeps the law
• Arkansas RKBA amendment certified — ammunition, accessories, components
• ATF: breach hit a standalone system; agency says eForms untouched
• Cheeseman v. NJ won 10–5 en banc — but the mandate is stayed, bans still enforceable
